lore_echoes.name: Crypt Builder's Lament
lore_echoes.subtitle_text: We built this place to seal away the darkness... but I fear we may have sealed ourselves in with it.

lore_echoes.name: Forest Guardian's Warning
lore_echoes.subtitle_text: The forest remembers all who pass through. Tread carefully, for the trees have long memories.

lore_echoes.name: Fallen Knight's Last Words
lore_echoes.subtitle_text: Tell my family... I fought until the end. The creature came from the shadows. Beware the darkness.

lore_echoes.name: Ancient Mage's Discovery
lore_echoes.subtitle_text: I have found it! The source of the corruption lies beneath the old temple. If only I had more time...
